comment: Clean redraw of the Ross Stereo Delay (Feb 1979, PWM filter control): 3x SAD1024, 571 compander, 4013 clock divider, no designators, so parts are grouped by value. Op amp and 4016/4013 chip counts are inferred from the sections drawn.
uncertain: 1u 100v: one label between two caps; read as both being 1u 100v
Diodes: drawn as filled red diode symbols, could be LEDs used as limiters
rows: local and remote output series resistors
drawn '1K' or '1k': input, clock transistor, gain stage, clock emitter, last SAD1024 output
five per filter chain (two 4016 PWM filters per chain, two chains)
clock trim leg; cut-off trim leg
SAD1024 pin 11 loads (two) and pin 6 loads (three)
drawn '47k' or '47K': two output pulldowns, 571 input, filter output, two SAD1024 interstage
drawn '100K' or '100k': four in the mix amps, one in the 571 expander feedback, six SAD1024 bias
Vb bias divider and input bias
two mix-amp feedback caps; one clock cap drawn '33P'
across the 10K at the first filter chain output
filter output coupling and two SAD1024 interstage couplings
local mix, remote mix, delay feedback line, 571 compressor pin 10/15, expander input, bias trim
100v; label '1u 100v' sits between the two caps feeding the 571 compressor's 47k and 33k
electrolytic: Vb, two outputs, delay feedback line, 571 pin 16, before the clipping diodes
no value drawn: clock-transistor emitter cap (electrolytic) and cut-off trim cap to ground
no part number given; two back-to-back limiting diodes to ground after the compressor, one in the clock oscillator
dual op amp; seven sections drawn (input buffer, two mix amps, four filter stages)
quad analog switch; eight sections drawn as PWM filter switches
dual flip-flop; four sections drawn as the clock divider
hex inverter (gates A-F, pins 1-11), part number not given
unnamed, drawn '47k lin'; on the delay return line, probably feedback/regen
unnamed, across the last SAD1024 outputs (balance)
